_doc: PLACEHOLDER-draft — Sérgio voice pass pending on every string below. Session 70. FLOPPYSHEEP is HIS name and his ask ('just feel like the need to the FloppySheep to be there would be good'). It is the mascot game on Vera's phone: one thumb, tap to hop, no timer, nothing to beat. ⚑ WHY IT BELONGS, and why it had to be BUILT rather than written down: it is one tap away WHILE A COMMENT SITS UNANSWERED, which is what everybody does at work. The piece says NOTHING about that — no scolding, no timer, no guilt, no ledger entry, ever. And it is the same publisher's lamb (`publisher` below): the brand still ships delight while its serious arm has become a workflow. THAT is the joke, and it is on the apparatus.
_docRegister: ⚑ IT IS NOT RESPITE. E3 has no respite — Sérgio's decision, confirmed, and this does not quietly reintroduce one. FloppySheep is `operable`: the apparatus's own cheerful product, made by the same people who made the correction list. Do not treat it as a shelter, do not let it become a reward, and do not gate anything on it. It must also be GENUINELY FUN — a game that is deliberately bad would be the piece sneering at her for playing it, and Vera is never the joke.
_docScore: The hop count is the GAME's own, shown inside the game's own frame, in the game's own cheerful voice — that is what a 2016 casual game does. Nothing is carried out of it: no best score, no streak, no session record, nothing filed to the ledger, and no number the piece ever refers to. A best-score line would make it a reward, which is the one thing it must never become.
title: FloppySheep
_docFences: The course, authored rather than generated — same law as the comment thread's arrivals, and the same reason: nothing in this piece rolls dice. `gap` is how far the course travels before the next fence appears; `h` is the fence's height in game units. The list cycles, and the run speeds up gently with every fence cleared, so the same twenty fences stop being the same twenty fences after a while. Tuned by playing it.
